text_block_list.text:
The season of scorching heat is here,
announcing
the beginning of this year's
summer camp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What is synonymous with summer? The
sun! And
what is synonymous with the
sun? The Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Thus, the summer is my season! This year will bring forth the Overlord Nouveau!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We've only just started and Opera O's
already
lost me... I guess she has
something new up her
sleeve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Overlord Nouveau is, in other
words, a whole
new me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
An all-powerful me, the target of
countless,
envious eyes...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I shall conquer them all en route to an

overwhelming victory!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
This is the Overlord Nouveau, for even
the
Overlord must evolve.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehehe... This ocean, is it not ideal
for
acquiring more strength, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Swimming through rough waters and
sprinting
across the sand... The beach
presents an ideal
training environment
for building up strength.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The forces of nature themselves shall
grant me
new power. Yes, I can feel it...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Poseidon will rise from the waves,
bestowing
terrible power unto me!
Bwaahaha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
...Apparently, she doesn't anticipate
putting in
the work herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
No matter the course of events, I shall
emerge as
a new being this summer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Something will happen. And if it doesn't, then I will make it happen!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So that I may become a lord who gains
victory
with ease, no matter who or what
pursues me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
